The eight-goal striker faces an estimated absence of around two months, although his exact recovery timetable remains dependent on rehabilitation.

Daniel Bîrligea is expected to compete with Bobček to lead the attack and has already demonstrated his scoring ability with a brace against Lecce. [...] Daniel Maldini has scored five of Cagliari's nine Serie A goals, leaving the hosts particularly reliant on his contribution in the final third.
